source_frame.frame_rule: Include every record for com.squareup.okhttp3:mockwebserver whose previous_version contains 3.14.9 and breaking_version is 4.0.0; current_version is not an exclusion filter.

source_repository.chronology_note: The FSE probe order is not release chronology: 4.0.0 was released in 2019, while the 3.x maintenance tag 3.14.9 was released in 2020 from the sibling branch.

mechanisms.subject: Promote some Util functions to be extensions
mechanisms.mechanism: MockWebServer construction now invokes Kotlin top-level immutableListOf. The released 4.0.0 bytecode calls okhttp3.internal.Util.immutableListOf(Object[]), which is absent from OkHttp 3.12.0.
mechanisms.target_dependency_shape: Retrofit 2.5.0 is declared before MockWebServer and brings OkHttp 3.12.0; replacing only MockWebServer with 4.0.0 leaves its constructor linked to the older OkHttp binary.

mechanisms.subject: Okio upgrade post kotlin (#4814)
mechanisms.mechanism: OkHttp moves from Okio 1.17.2 to 2.2.2. OkHttp 4.0.0's okhttp3.internal.Util static initializer links okio.Options.Companion, which does not exist in Okio 1.17.5.
mechanisms.target_dependency_shape: The JavaSDK 3.14.9 snapshot fixes okhttp.version at 3.14.9 and okio.version at 1.17.5; changing the shared OkHttp version to 4.0.0 retains the incompatible Okio pin.
